ruleDefinitions.name: Compress Data and Lock With Password for Exfiltration With WINZIP
ruleDefinitions.description: An adversary may compress or encrypt data that is collected prior to exfiltration using 3rd party utilities

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*winzip\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*winzip64\\\.exe.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-s\\.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-min\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-a\\ .*")))
